title: Hip Artist West End  1.5 miles to Broadway
description:
This Midtown Nashville, family friendly home is filled with original Nashville artist paintings and historic music  photographs.
One can walk to Vanderbilt, Centennial Park/Parthenon and Broadway(Downtown), Belmont, Historic Music Row within 1.5 miles very close to restaurants and coffee shops. 6 parking spaces on the property off of the alley. On street parking right next to the home.

Other things to note
The home has a cornhole board.
